title.suggested: Tom Allen Fights Under American Colors

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that an admirer gave the paper the colors Tom Allen wore against Gallagher, a silk handkerchief bearing the American eagle and flags; Allen claimed to be an American citizen.

metadata.notes: Page masthead reads 'Daily Democrat', Thursday morning, August 19, 1869.

facts.fact: Allen fought Gallagher under American colors, a silk handkerchief with the American eagle, stars and two American flags; he claimed to be an American citizen and said he would fight under American colors from then on
